description: Check an EU VAT number against the European Commission's VIES service: valid or not, and the registered company name and address where the member state shares them, with the check time. Accepts the number with its country prefix in any spacing (SE556703748501, DE 123 456 789, GR or EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland). Use to verify a B2B customer before invoicing without VAT, or to confirm a supplier. Example: vat=SE556703748501. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

vat.description: VAT number with its 2-letter EU country prefix

name: vat_validate
title: VAT number validation, EU VIES
